configuration.evidence: Several disconnected fragments lie one address below existing targets. Test whether replacing a single global branch-address bit can explain them without stack failures.
limitations: Only one global address bit changes at a time; contextual decoding and joint changes remain untested.
Dispatch targets and condition semantics are held fixed at explicit hypotheses.
Repeated physical source bits are permitted and reported, not silently excluded.
The graph explores both conditional outcomes; a possible failure is not proof that hardware executes it.
Coverage and target score do not measure hardware truth. No runtime or datapath claim is made.
